name: 79108 · Amarillo, TX
findings: ZIP 79108 (Amarillo) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (71% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79108 (Amarillo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
